name: 002-tower-resolved-dns
description: Shipped by bazzite-tower: name resolution always works under DefaultAction deny, so OS image updates can reach their registry. Only the system resolver (/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-resolved) running as a system account (uid below 1000; systemd-resolve's uid is allocated at build time) may reach DNS (port 53) or DNS-over-TLS (port 853) over UDP or TCP. Deny rules and blocklists still win.
